items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: Sinatra was a family friend you know. I grew up in Hollywood and my father was in show biz and my mom was too and they were friends of Sinatras who lived in our neighborhood.

ctx.x: Hopefully long and profitable. A career in jazz is what I dreamed of from when I was about 11 years old, even before I knew what I was dreaming about, and it came together in a strange way. While viewing a movie with my mother, “The Man With the Golden Arm” with Frank Sinatra. If you know the story then you know I don’t have to explain it. And it featured — I’d been getting into music, west coast jazz particularly. I had certain favorites and they were all in this movie. At some point there was a big band scene,…
You were playing the saxophone at the time, weren’t you.
